methodology.notes: Custom agent scaffold using Claude Opus 4.6 as the base LLM with the standard tau2-bench LocalAgent interface. The scaffold adds domain-specific supplementary instructions (critical reminders) appended to the system prompt for each domain: telecom (roaming checks, MMS prerequisites, data usage handling, line suspension), airline (multi-step tracking, compensation rules, cancellation/modification/booking procedures), and retail (no additional instructions). The core agent loop, tools, and environment are unmodified from the standard tau2-bench framework. Evaluated with 1 trial per task across all 3 domains.

verification.details: Modified agent system prompt with domain-specific supplementary instructions appended to the base prompt. Standard tau2-bench tools and environment unchanged. 1 trial per task (Pass@1 only). All tasks evaluated without omission.
